These are banner-like, so the ad value a half hour displaces is low. Advertisers such as TEMU (s01.e45, s05.e15) already rotate through those cards. Here one of them can sponsor the game instead. In return it gets a single labeled credit line at the top of the feed for the ad-free half hour. That slot exists only to show the sponsor and reorders no stories. No paid ad-free plan was seen in the explored screens, and the paywall flagged on the third article open (s64) was never seen with a price or benefit, so the idea does not rest on it.
